frame.axes: right-handed metres: +x right (curb), +y forward (nose), +z up; origin = cell pivot on the ground
frame.rot: unit quaternion [x,y,z,w]; local to the parent bone
frame.rotEuler: the same rotation, degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X (yaw z, pitch y, roll x)
frame.pos: metres, local to the parent bone
frame.u: k/frames, or k/(frames-1) on settle clips (reach, mount*)
frame.face: per-frame HeadIso look for the raster stamp on the head-anchored quad
frame.tool: degrees; tool_L/R local +y runs along the tool, tool_*_1/2 carry RodIso's bend as two chords
frame.bone: bindMesh: bone[k] = [[boneIndex, weight], ...] for vertex k; one pair at weight 1 except the BLENDED rings
frame.rock: deck rock is a live hull transform; a clip made with opts.rock carries only the counter-lean rig 6 poses from it

blended.why: rig 6 lerps the apron rings from a floor-anchored hem to the torso
the sleeve hem sits at a fraction of a tube whose drawn length changes

blended.where: sleeve-end ring 0.80/0.90 and skin-start ring 0.76/0.86 (long sleeves)
